title: Minor eitr mead
content:
# Minor eitr mead

Type: Mead | Internal ID: MeadEitrMinor | Source: Fermenter | Usage: Drinking | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Mead base: Minor eitr x1 | Duration: 10s | Cooldown: 2m | Eitr Regen: +125 Eitr over 10s

# Introduction

Minor eitr mead is a Mistlands-tier consumable item fermented from Mead base: Minor eitr.

## Recipe

Mead base: Minor eitr is produced in a Mead ketill with:
• 10 Honey
• 5 Sap
• 2 Jotun puffs
• 5 Magecap
Six Minor eitr meads are produced by fermenting the mead base for two in-game days.

## Effect

Upon consumption, it restores 125 eitr over 10 seconds.
A 2-min cooldown is applied preventing consumption of another eitr mead.

Categorias: Mead, Fermenter recipes, Items
